title: Ancestor rediscovers the seven lost Spanish gold mines of New Mexico

tellings.quote: goes looking in New Mexico for the uh the seven lost Spanish gold mines of of southern New Mexico and within a year he discovered them and he opened up these 450 year old gold mines

plain: An ancestor of the researcher Luke Caverns went looking for the seven lost Spanish gold mines of southern New Mexico, found them within a year, and opened mines some 450 years old. Caverns tells this family story to Michels as something passed down to him.
